g.text: −log σ(s) for a match, −log(1 − σ(s)) for everything else
every cell is its own yes or no question
label 1 on the diagonal, 0 everywhere else
no row sum, no column sum
so the table can be cut into blocks
every GPU scores its own block
all at the same time, σ(s) in every cell
the two off diagonal blocks hold no matches at all, and that is fine, their cells still learn to say no
